reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Equal access to AI benefits
themes.definition: All nations and societies should benefit equally from AI's transformative power, with efforts to close the technological gap for LDCs.
themes.inclusion: Include passages insisting no society be deprived of AI benefits or that all nations benefit equally.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages about AI legal frameworks without an equity element.
themes.boundary_cases: Hosting the UN Technology Bank for LDCs fits here and also AI_UN_ROLE / AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: no society should be deprived of these benefits
we believe that all nations should benefit equally from the transformative power of such breakthrough technologies

themes.label: AI as tool of domination
themes.definition: Warning that AI should not become a new instrument of domination or source of injustice and conflict.
themes.inclusion: Include passages warning against AI used for domination or power asymmetries.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general benefit-sharing statements without a domination framing.
themes.boundary_cases: Mentions of technology weaponized in attacks belong to AI_CYBER_SECURITY instead.

examples.quote: AI technologies should be used for the benefit of humanity, not as a new tool of domination.

themes.label: Binding international legal framework on AI
themes.definition: Calls for a common international legal framework and a UN convention on AI, citing loss of control.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for binding international law, treaties or conventions on AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Reference to a UN convention also warrants AI_UN_ROLE; 'difficult to control' framing may be AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL.

examples.quote: It is long overdue now to establish a common international legal framework for AI.

themes.label: AI becoming difficult to control
themes.definition: AI described as increasingly difficult to control, posing a risk comparable to other global threats.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI is becoming uncontrollable or poses loss-of-control risk.
themes.exclusion: Exclude risks limited to misuse by criminals or states.
themes.boundary_cases: If the uncontrollability claim is used only to justify governance, code both this and AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: We are also facing the same risk with artificial intelligence, AI, which is becoming increasingly difficult to control.

themes.label: Children's rights in digital world
themes.definition: Initiatives to protect children's rights in digital environments in the context of AI.
themes.inclusion: Include passages proposing child protection instruments or rules in digital/AI contexts.
themes.exclusion: Exclude children's rights content unrelated to digital technology.
themes.boundary_cases: AI in education for children is AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION rather than protection.

examples.quote: We have prepared a children's rights convention in the digital world, and we will soon open this up for ratification.

themes.label: Technology weaponized in cyberterror
themes.definition: Technologies like AI can be turned into deadly weapons through cyberterror attacks.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI or breakthrough technology to cyberterror or weaponized attacks outside formal military AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Attacks involving compromised devices framed as technology misuse fit here.

examples.quote: last week’s cyberterror attacks in Lebanon showed once again how those technologies can be turned into deadly weapons

value.rationale: Turkish passages emphasize equitable AI benefits and against AI domination (with the UN Technology Bank), later shifting to AI as hard to control and calling for a UN convention; they also note child digital rights and weaponized technology.
